meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 让 Claude 把经典单机器人 Slack 安装,按每个已有 agent group 迁移成独立的命名 Slack 应用,保留 agent 身份、工作区、记忆与接线行为;迁移可选,也可以只记录你选择继续用经典方式。它不会新建 agent group,也不改动 agent 工作区。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示 Slack agents 需求时触发,或之后任何时候单独运行 /migrate-slack-agents。前提是检测到经典单机器人 Slack 状态。

say.text: 列出所有经典 Slack 接线的 agent group 和建议的 slug
我选择继续用经典 Slack,帮我记下这个决定
say.note: 不改动,仅确认更新要求

howto.what_en: Migrates a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group, keeping identities, workspaces, memory and wiring; or records your choice to stay on classic. It never creates agent groups.
howto.when_en: Triggers when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or any time later as a standalone run.

say_en.text: Run /migrate-slack-agents and show me the dry-run map first
List my classic Slack-wired agent groups and proposed slugs
I'll stay on classic Slack - record that decision
